title: Puttering Pebble Cuttlefish
statement: A palm-sized cuttlefish with an ink-blue mantle and flickering gold freckles putters through a twilight tank of ribbon grass, smooth porcelain pebbles, and one enormous frosted-glass arch. It spends its afternoons arranging pebbles into elaborate spirals, then gently moves the middle pebble somewhere surprising and hovers back to reconsider.
